story.title: Shabana shares 2017 party video; Sridevi and Satish appear
story.summary: Shabana Azmi shared an old Instagram video from a musical evening at her home, featuring Shankar Mahadevan singing Mitwa and Sonu Nigam among performers. Fans were moved to spot the late Sridevi and Satish Kaushik among guests. Believed to be from Javed Akhtar's 2017 birthday, the clip drew nostalgic reactions online.

story.title: 'The Hunger Games' scores huge USD 120 million opening
story.summary: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping premiered successfully, grossing USD 120 million in North America over the weekend. This latest installment marks a resurgence for the franchise that had seen declining interest. The film featured a new cast while retaining beloved characters like Haymitch Abernathy.
